scripts.build: npm run api:bundle && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.lint: oxlint src shared functions/src server tests scripts
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-ipl-auction "vitest run tests/integration"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database,functions --project demo-ipl-auction "playwright test"
scripts.emulators: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,database,functions --project demo-ipl-auction
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run functions:build && firebase deploy
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run api:check && npm run validate:players && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:free: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-ipl-auction "E2E_FREE=1 playwright test"
scripts.api:bundle: esbuild server/vercel.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// GENERATED by npm run api:bundle from server/vercel.ts — do not edit." --outfile=api/index.js --log-level=warning
scripts.api:check: npm run api:bundle && git diff --exit-code -- api/index.js
